_readme: The ten designs. deck.json "theme": "<id>" picks one; theme/slides.css is the base (drawing), theme/themes/<id>.css restyles it. logo: auto = white on dark slides, white = always white, color = always the colour logo. tools/themes.mjs draws the preview sheet.
